message:
As we think about being prepared, it's easy to overlook the simple joys of connecting with our kids through low-tech activities. This resource offers some wonderful ideas that help our little ones learn about safety and preparedness while having fun. 

Rediscovering classic games and hands-on activities can bring us closer together while equipping us with valuable skills. Let's embrace this opportunity to make learning a shared adventure! What’s one favorite activity you’ve enjoyed together recently? 😌
